A '''repulse booster''' was a part used in [[Podracer/Legends|podracers]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the boosters could be used as trade parts on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

==History==
[[Tomo's mother]] gave [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] a repulse booster after he rescued her [[Tomo|son]] from being held captive by [[Neg]]. Qui-Gon was then able to trade the repulse booster for a [[servo control system]], which he needed to fix [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]'s [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|podracer]].

Qui-Gon could also obtain the repulse booster by killing Tomo's mother and stealing it from her.
